edges.mechanism: Iron binds levothyroxine in the gut and reduces its absorption; separate doses by at least 4 h and recheck TSH when starting or stopping iron.
edges.evidence: Case reports (including persistence despite 4-h separation, 2026), review, and US label; no HIP-specific study

edges.mechanism: Iron chelates quinolones; ferrous sulfate reduced AUC by 73% (norfloxacin), 57% (ciprofloxacin) and 25% (ofloxacin). Give ciprofloxacin 2 h before or 6 h after iron.
edges.evidence: Crossover PK trials in healthy volunteers plus US label; HIP-specific data absent

edges.mechanism: Iron-tetracycline chelation seriously impairs absorption of tetracycline, oxytetracycline, methacycline and doxycycline; a 2026 case reported doxycycline treatment failure.
edges.evidence: Human PK studies, review and case report

edges.mechanism: Iron salts chelate levodopa/carbidopa and reduce bioavailability; label advises caution with co-administration.
edges.evidence: Animal absorption model plus label statement

edges.mechanism: Ferrous sulfate/gluconate reduced methyldopa absorption (29.1% to 7.9%) and raised BP in 4 of 5 treated hypertensive patients.
edges.evidence: Randomized crossover in 12 volunteers plus small patient series

edges.mechanism: A 90% fall in mycophenolic acid AUC with co-administered iron in healthy Japanese volunteers was not reproduced in transplant RCTs or a crossover trial.
edges.evidence: Conflicting PK studies; RCT evidence suggests no clinically relevant interaction

edges.mechanism: Multivalent cations (including iron) impair oral alendronate absorption; take other oral products at least 30 min after the dose.
edges.evidence: US label

edges.mechanism: Long-term PPI use is associated with iron deficiency anemia (RR 2.56), probably by impairing non-heme iron absorption; the effect on heme iron is not established.
edges.evidence: Meta-analysis of observational studies

edges.mechanism: Calcium is the only dietary factor that inhibits heme as well as non-heme iron absorption: 165 mg reduced absorption in meals and 800 mg cut 5 mg heme-iron absorption by 37.7%. Chronic 600 mg/d did not change heme bioavailability, and the MA found no Hb reduction.
edges.evidence: Isotope absorption studies, RCT and meta-analysis

edges.mechanism: Magnesium oxide (with calcium carbonate) in prenatal multivitamin-mineral products lowered iron absorption; separate dosing.
edges.evidence: Crossover absorption study (non-heme iron); not tested with HIP

edges.mechanism: Zinc inhibits non-heme iron absorption at Zn:Fe >=1:1 (10 mg Fe), and iron supplements lower zinc absorption. Heme iron did not inhibit zinc absorption, so the interaction is mainly relevant to the non-heme component or co-taken iron salts.
edges.evidence: Human absorption studies

edges.mechanism: Curcumin is an iron chelator that repressed hepcidin and induced iron deficiency in mice with marginal iron status. A formulated curcumin increased iron uptake in vitro, so the effect may depend on formulation.
edges.evidence: Animal and in-vitro data; one human turmeric case

edges.mechanism: A human case of iron-deficiency anemia on high-dose turmeric extract despite iron supplementation resolved after stopping turmeric; mechanism is iron chelation in the gut.
edges.evidence: Case report plus animal mechanism

edges.mechanism: Ascorbic acid (100-1000 mg) did not change heme-iron absorption in humans but enhances non-heme iron. In vitro it offsets low-level polyphenol inhibition of heme transport, so it gives little added benefit for HIP.
edges.evidence: Human radio-iron study and Caco-2 data

edges.mechanism: Tea had no appreciable effect on heme iron absorption in humans, but high polyphenol concentrations (EGCG, grape seed, green tea) inhibited heme transport in Caco-2 cells. Tea strongly inhibits non-heme iron.
edges.evidence: Human single-meal study, in vitro, polyphenol supplement trial

edges.mechanism: Daily prebiotic-enriched yogurt for 12 days increased heme iron bioavailability by 56% without changing non-heme iron.
edges.evidence: Small randomized isotope study in 24 women

edges.mechanism: Hepcidin deficiency causes systemic iron overload in the liver, pancreas and heart; supplemental iron adds to the load. C282Y-homozygous or compound-heterozygous women with high heme intake had the highest ferritin.
edges.evidence: Disease review; population study

edges.mechanism: An HFE-variant x heme-intake interaction was found for T2D risk (P=0.029). Compound heterozygotes absorb more non-heme iron, but C282Y heterozygotes do not absorb heme iron more than controls.
edges.evidence: Nested case-control, isotope absorption study

edges.mechanism: Iron poisoning is a major cause of unintentional poisoning death in young children; serious toxicity from about 28 mg/kg. Unit-dose packaging cut US deaths from 29 to 1.
edges.evidence: Poison-center pre/post data; clinical series

edges.mechanism: HIP gave no advantage over oral ferrous sulfate or IV iron sucrose for Hb or TSAT and gave consistently lower ferritin, at 7-fold higher cost than ferrous sulfate.
edges.evidence: 3 RCTs (SR), HEMATOCRIT RCT

edges.mechanism: Post-RYGB iron deficiency did not respond to HIP but did to ferrous sulfate; heme-iron absorption fell from 23.9% to 6.2% after surgery.
edges.evidence: Small RCT stopped early; prospective isotope study

edges.mechanism: Higher dietary heme intake is associated with T2D (RR 1.20; +16% per 1 mg/d; HR 1.26 top vs bottom quintile) and with adverse insulinemia and inflammatory profiles. Not shown for HIP supplements in iron-deficient people.
edges.evidence: Observational cohort meta-analysis and pooled US cohorts

edges.mechanism: The manufacturer states that heme iron polypeptide may give false-positive guaiac (peroxidase) tests but not FIT, which is specific to human hemoglobin. Oral ferrous sulfate did not make Hemoccult II tests positive in vivo.
edges.evidence: Manufacturer statement; human study of non-heme iron

edges.mechanism: HIP-treated patients have lower ferritin than those on ferrous or IV iron at similar Hb/TSAT, so ferritin trends may understate response or reflect lower stores. Interpret alongside TSAT and Hb.
edges.evidence: CKD RCTs and SR
